$comment: Waivers for the dependency audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs). One entry per advisory: id (GHSA), reason (why it is not exploitable here, or why no fix exists, and who tracks the fix), expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days out). An entry past its date fails the gate again.

entries.reason: body-parser: found by the first run of the gate (2026-10-28) and NOT yet assessed beyond this note: a fix exists (npm audit fix, minor); the API sits behind the reverse proxy that caps request bodies. Fix tracked as S-22 follow-up in docs/roadmap/PROGRESS.md.

multer: found by the first run of the gate (2026-10-28) and NOT yet assessed beyond this note: fixed only by NestJS platform-express 12 (a major, Dependabot PR open); the API accepts no multipart upload through multer (photos use signed URLs). Fix tracked as S-22 follow-up in docs/roadmap/PROGRESS.md.

node-forge: found by the first run of the gate (2026-10-28) and NOT yet assessed beyond this note: a fix exists (npm audit fix); a transitive dependency of the Expo tooling, never in the API image. Fix tracked as S-22 follow-up in docs/roadmap/PROGRESS.md.

sharp: found by the first run of the gate (2026-10-28) and NOT yet assessed beyond this note: a fix exists (npm audit fix); sharp only makes thumbnails of images the owner uploaded, never renders SVG from a stranger. Fix tracked as S-22 follow-up in docs/roadmap/PROGRESS.md.

shell-quote: found by the first run of the gate (2026-10-28) and NOT yet assessed beyond this note: CRITICAL; a fix exists (npm audit fix); a transitive dependency of the Expo dev tooling that runs on a developer machine, never in the API image or the app bundle. Fix tracked as S-22 follow-up in docs/roadmap/PROGRESS.md.

source-map-js: found by the first run of the gate (2026-10-28) and NOT yet assessed beyond this note: a fix exists (npm audit fix); a build-time dependency, never in the API image or the app bundle. Fix tracked as S-22 follow-up in docs/roadmap/PROGRESS.md.

zod: found by the first run of the gate (2026-10-28) and NOT yet assessed beyond this note: fixed in zod 4.6.6; the contracts validate bodies the API already caps in size. Fix tracked as S-22 follow-up in docs/roadmap/PROGRESS.md.

decode-uri-component: published 2026-10-30 and NOT fixed upstream (the advisory covers every release up to 0.4.2, so there is nothing to upgrade to). It arrives only through expo-router > query-string 7, which parses URL query strings inside the mobile app; the worst case is a crafted deep link making the app itself spin, with no data exposed and no server involved. It is not in the API image. Fix tracked as S-22 follow-up in docs/roadmap/PROGRESS.md: re-check upstream, then drop this entry.
